preconditions: Sealed rank1..32, multiplicity-free supports; each triple-count per total has at most rank distinct first channels and each four-count at most rank squared channel pairs. Block dimension<=rank. Width1..rank.
scope: Independent integer envelope evaluation under source-discharged path/cardinality bounds. All per-label path counters fit32-bit usize and polynomial bookkeeping fitsu128. This is not a Rust execution, allocator bound, scalar bit-cost claim or law proof.
